nodes.name: 404.html
nodes.summary: Jinja2 template extending base.html that renders a user-facing 'Live location not found' error page when a requested order's live location cannot be resolved.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Jinja2 template inheritance ({% extends %}) with title and content blocks.

nodes.name: base.html
nodes.summary: Base Jinja2 layout template providing the HTML skeleton, responsive viewport, and shared CSS styles used by all derived FastAPI page templates in the OrdeloAgent frontend.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines two overridable Jinja2 blocks: 'title' and 'content', following the standard Jinja2 template inheritance pattern.

nodes.name: get-config.html
nodes.summary: Standalone HTML template that renders Start Job / Stop Job action buttons, accepting href URLs from the FastAPI route context via Jinja2 template variables to control pg_cron job scheduling through the browser.

nodes.name: live-location-map.html
nodes.summary: Standalone HTML template that renders an interactive Google Maps page displaying a rider's delivery route using hardcoded location coordinates, with DirectionsService polylines connecting sequential GPS points and a bicycle SVG marker at the final position.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Google Maps JavaScript API with async DirectionsService calls to draw turn-by-turn route segments between chronological rider location points. Currently uses hardcoded sample coordinates rather than dynamic template variables.

nodes.name: waba_embedded_signup.html
nodes.summary: Jinja2 HTML template that loads the Facebook JavaScript SDK and implements the WhatsApp Business Account embedded signup flow, forwarding WA_EMBEDDED_SIGNUP message events and FB OAuth auth responses to the FastAPI backend via POST requests.
nodes.languageNotes: Jinja2 variables inject app_id, graph_api_version, and configuration_id into the FB.init and FB.login calls at render time. Event messages from Facebook's iframe are forwarded to /twilio-webhook/waba-embedded-signup.
